name: Ormer's Revenge
summary: At the ruined Whelgar Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid sends you after the raptors that drove out his expedition. With the smaller scouts culled, he wants the Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws killed.

sections.title: Escalating the Hunt
sections.body: Ormer Ironbraid turns your blades on the adult raptors in the lower dig. You have already thinned the smaller juveniles that overran the upper camp, but Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws still threaten any hope of reclaiming the excavation. They tear through dwarven prospectors and leave the trenches strewn with shattered crates and abandoned picks.

sections.title: Blood in the Trenches
sections.body: Raptors have made their nests in the excavation pits. From the ridge above the dig, Ormer directs you into the mud to strike at the mature beasts. Prospector Whelgar and his crew hope to salvage ancient relics, but Ormer is consumed by vengeance. He demands a heavy toll of dead Scytheclaws and Razormaws before he turns to the site's apex terror.

faq.q: Why is Ormer so angry at these raptors?
faq.answer: The mottled raptors swarmed the Whelgar Excavation Site, drove out the dwarven team, and slaughtered those who could not escape. Ormer Ironbraid was displaced and left bitter, and he will not let the beasts control the dig without making them pay in blood.

faq.q: Where are the Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws found?
faq.answer: Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws prowl the lower dig trenches and surrounding earthworks at the Whelgar Excavation Site, east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr in the Wetlands.

Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven member of the Explorers' League stationed at the Whelgar Excavation Site. After the dig was overrun, he made it his personal mission to exterminate the raptor pack infesting their work.

faq.q: What happens after culling these raptors?
faq.answer: After you cull the Scytheclaws and Razormaws, Ormer turns his attention to Sarltooth, the large raptor he believes leads the local pack. He directs you to end the source of the raptor infestation.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to other tasks in the excavation site?
faq.answer: Yes. As you hunt raptors in the lower dig for Ormer, you can also help Prospector Whelgar and his team with 'Uncovering the Past' by collecting fragmented earthen artifacts scattered across the same trenches.

faq.q: Why were the dwarves digging here in the first place?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League of Ironforge established the Whelgar Excavation Site to search for titan relics and uncover the ancient history of the dwarven race. Aggressive wildlife halted their work when it overran the dig.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you share the Explorers' League's fierce pride and its refusal to let wild beasts halt the search for your ancestral past.
As a hunter, you face the Wetlands' Mottled raptors, territorial pack hunters that make tracking lethal in the enclosed, muddy trenches.
As an Alliance member, you help reclaim the Whelgar Excavation Site and secure safe operations along the eastern road between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.
